surfaces.name: Collections.IndexedHeap: ordering contract (caller comparison, then last-set stamp), insert, decreaseKey, update, remove, pop, peek, contains, count
surfaces.evidence: fixture-schema.v1 operation 2; cases 2001-2006; FsCheck map model and lazy-deletion equivalence

surfaces.name: Numerics.Fixed: add, sub, mul, div, sqrt, neg, abs, ofInt, ofRatio, toIntFloor, toIntCeiling, toIntRound, compare, min, max and the operators
surfaces.evidence: fixture-schema.v1 operations 3 and 10; cases 3001-3004 including the ADR-0098 §3 F2 edge vectors, and case 10001, a 10^5-pair fixed-seed sweep digested per function and recomputed exactly in Python; FsCheck and a 10^5-pair sweep against exact BigInteger oracles

surfaces.name: Numerics.Fixed: ofFloat, toFloat
surfaces.evidence: documented contract: toFloat is exact; ofFloat rounds to nearest, ties upward, saturating, NaN to 0 (FsCheck round-trip and half-step bound)

surfaces.name: Graph.BestFirst: search, dijkstra, astar, distances (integer costs; deterministic caller functions)
surfaces.evidence: fixture-schema.v1 operation 4; cases 4001-4012; FsCheck against BFS, Bellman-Ford and exhaustive enumeration

surfaces.name: Random.Xoshiro128: seed, ofState, state, next, nextBelow, nextInRange, split, jump

surfaces.name: Random.Xoshiro128: nextFloat
surfaces.evidence: documented contract: the high 24 bits of one draw divided by 2^24, exact in IEEE doubles

surfaces.name: Numerics.Percentile: rank, ofSorted, percent (exact integer nearest rank)
surfaces.evidence: fixture-schema.v1 operation 8; cases 8001-8002; exhaustive check over count 1..300 and every fraction with denominator <= 100; FsCheck against BigInteger

surfaces.name: Graph.Scc: tarjan, cycles, componentOf (iterative)

surfaces.name: Graph.UnionFind: create, representative (smallest member), union, connected, count, sets, partition
surfaces.evidence: fixture-schema.v1 operation 7; cases 7001-7005; FsCheck against BFS components; 10^5 chained unions under Node

surfaces.name: Decision.Arbitration: step, precedence (bands, per-band order, pre-emption, suspension, resumption, cancel permissions, cancel-all, release, waiting limit)
surfaces.evidence: fixture-schema.v1 operation 9; cases 9001-9005; FsCheck invariants after every input over 400 runs and a 300-run no-starvation drain

notes: Unclassified is not admissible for a new surface (ADR-0098 §3 rule 2); every public surface is listed above.
Changing the output of a LockstepExact surface for any input is a breaking change with a new profileId. The two heap ordering contracts are frozen: FS.GG.Game.Core pins them (ADR-0098 §1).
status becomes published-contract only when a released package carries this profile.
